fusions.name: Buckling Ground
fusions.desc: Roots heave the ground under every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Geode Pod
fusions.desc: Throws a stone-shelled seed pod that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tilled Ground
fusions.desc: Turns the ground where you stand into a growing bed for 10 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
